readClasses.law: The ratchet was blind to every read outside engines/modern: the agnostic skin and the rest of the authored CSS that the base entrypoint imports under every engine, and literal var() reads inline in component TS/TSX, paint under Modern exactly like the Modern skin does. Measured 2026-09-25 at 6f5faa6f4 after WO-EVI-03 found 11 dead channels its tests pin that this ratchet could not see. Frozen engines (classic, rustic) stay out for the same reason as before; nothing else does.
readClasses.shape: names -> { readers, family, owner, ownerProposal }. A read without producer that is not a row (or a new reader of a row) is anonymous and red; a row or reader that stopped being debt is red until deleted. No write mode: the ledger only shrinks by hand.
readClasses.ownership: owner is a work order id or null. The 11 WO-EVI-03 channels carried their proposal one by one; 10 have left (see exits, beside the three unrouted code-block siblings that followed them) and 1 remains. Every other row is ownerProposal null: unrouted debt, measured and visible, that the DT routes by family (produce the channel in its family deriver, or retire the read). It is not an exemption: a row leaves only when its read has a producer or is gone.

exits.law: A row that leaves the ledger is written here with its disposition and the lot that moved it. An exit is not a pin: the gate reads only the two read classes' names ledgers, and a name here read again without a producer is anonymous growth and red.
